objective: Implement and objectively verify the Bootstrap Self-Development Core.
acceptanceCriteria: Load and validate all required repository context.
Create, read, and update validated development tasks and state.
Run configured verification commands and retain structured results.
Generate a checkpoint from actual Git state.
Expose scriptable status, verify, checkpoint, and context CLI commands.
Pass the M00 automated acceptance checks.
notes: Keep M00 small and free of cloud AI, UI, scheduling, voice, browser, and OS automation.
